source.authoring: Hand-built. A Claude agent wrote this JSON by hand from fact-checked research and a merged fact key. It is not the output of the engine's AI loop answering a prompt. Its bytes are unchanged from the reviewed version.
source.license: Apache-2.0; procedural geometry, no images, models or stock assets

capture.machine: Apple M1 Mac mini (Macmini9,1), arm64; macOS 27.2
capture.note: check exited 0 with ok true, strict true, no warnings; legend Solved 16 · Not checked 20. Solved 16 = 15 model motions (shaft, impeller and turbine wheel of 5 engines) and 1 gravity-arrow direction. The engine computes no thrust, rpm, load split or hover balance. render wrote 7 step stills, hero.png, exploded.png, loop.gif, loop.mp4, story.mp4 and snapshot.json (2259 frames, about 0.031 s per frame). Only the 7 step stills and story.mp4 are public; hero.png is excluded (its helmet reaches into the title band), and the other outputs are not kept.

review.facts: Every factual sentence maps to a row of the merged fact key (F1-F20) in docs/assets/jet-suit/SOURCES.md. The key merges two independent AI model web fact-checks (GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 3.8 Flash).
review.verdict: An independent read-only review of the same JSON bytes gave PUBLIC-OK for the 7 step stills and story.mp4, with hero.png excluded. That review used renders from the PR #37 head (0a53cc6dec88d0584041c69eb18357d7c314b165) before its merge.
review.differenceFromReviewedRenders: Between 0a53cc6 and this commit the only renderer change is the subtitle line (medium weight, 85 % ink, was regular 60 %). The subtitle now names jet-suit.json, not the earlier working file name. All 7 new stills were inspected one by one: labels, captions, arrows and framing match the reviewed stills. A pixel diff also shows small rendering differences in under 1.7 % of colour channels; no label, arrow or caption moved.

story.mp4.from: render story.mp4, re-encoded for size (see reencode)

renderedOriginal.note: The engine's story.mp4 (1890 frames, 30 fps, 63 s, 7 beats of 9 s, no cuts, video only). Not kept in git: 15.9 MB.

story.mp4.reencode: AVFoundation only: AVAssetReader (32BGRA) to AVAssetWriter, H.264 High profile, average 1,000,000 bit/s, key frame every 60 frames, every source frame kept (1890 in, 1890 out). A small Swift script outside the repository; no other tool. Hold frames at 5.0, 32.5, 52.0 and 59.5 s were extracted and inspected: text and labels stay sharp.
